draft.text: You came in because your right finger has been hurting since you bent it back while skiing.
We found that your finger is painful when you move it, but you have no numbness, tingling, or weakness.
This may be due to an injury you got while skiing, possibly from bending your finger back.
You should keep using ice and ibuprofen as needed.
Avoid stressing the finger and come back in a week for imaging results.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because your right finger has been hurting since you bent it back while skiing.
We did not find any numbness, tingling, weakness, or problems with gripping objects in your finger or hand.
Your finger pain is likely from the injury you had while skiing.
You will need imaging tests like X-rays or MRI to check the injury.
You should keep using ice and ibuprofen as needed.
Avoid putting stress on your finger.
You will follow up with your doctor in a week after the imaging results are available.
